steps.name: 2 Years Ago — Part I
steps.objective: Visit the isolation rooms in Asgard and view the memories hidden in the stone towers.

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: Iris... Don't come... You mustn't come...!

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Ah! Iris, look up at the sky! It's Genepe!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Genepe...!

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: The Demon King seeks the immense <power> hidden in the Tyr bloodline...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: !! If the Demon King is in Yggdrasil now...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: ...Is he luring Lady Iris there?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...Hmph. Demon King or whatever he calls himself, his methods are pathetic.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: ...Hmm.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Then, Genepe, the reason the Demon King has captured you is...

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: ...Aaaaah... It hurts... It hurts so much... Please... Help me...!

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: No... No... You mustn't come... Aaaah!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: B-blood?!... How could he...?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Ugh... H-he looks like he's in so much pain... Ngh...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: S-steady yourself, Muwen! You have to be strong!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text:
...I will never forgive this.
Hold on, Genepe! I'll save you, no matter what...!

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: Ah... No, Iris. Run away. Please...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: ...He's gone.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: The Tyr boy... It seems he used the last of his strength to warn us.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text:
...
Muwen... Would you turn back here?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Huh? What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: This is my fight. Muwen... And... all of you... You don't need to join me in any more dangerous battles...

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: D-don't be ridiculous, Iris! We've been together all this way!

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Exactly. No need to start worrying about that now. After coming this far, what's yours and what's ours? You'll be in trouble without Muwen and me when you face the Demon King!

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: That's right! Besides, Iris...

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Without me, you do everything halfheartedly, sleep late, can't keep a beat or carry a tune, can't cook... Honestly, you're hopeless as an adult! How could I leave you alone? Ahem!

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Muwen's doing a fine job as your big sister!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text:
Oh... Hopeless as an adult...
W-wait! What do my singing and rhythm have to do with this?!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Hehe. True, the way the little one danced when we first met was really...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: K-Kaznoooo!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (Dancing...?)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: ...Hehe...

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Oh, Mr. Levi smiled! It's been a while since I saw that!

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: What a heartbreaker...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Lady Iris, not one of the companions who has come this far with you will sit out the battle against the Demon King.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Exactly. No fool would miss an event like this. It's surely once in a lifetime.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Lord Levi, Kazno...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Stop wasting my time with this nonsense. While we're standing here, that boy Genepe is still suffering, isn't he?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text:
...! Yes. You're right.
All right. I won't say any more.
Thank you, everyone. Truly.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text:
...Then... let's go! To Yggdrasil!
Let's defeat the Demon King!

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Understood. Before that... We should find Lord Siam, whom we became separated from.

lines.speaker: 무웬&조에
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Hmph! Always such a slow child.

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: So... in the end... you insist on coming?

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: ...Of course you do. Iris is a good girl. Hehehe...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text:
Hehehe...
It's been a long road, but at last we've come this far.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text:
Now that she's come this far, it's over. That girl is as good as in my hands.
I don't need a doll like you anymore.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...No, wait.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: To finish everything with certainty, I must give her complete [despair] and break her will to resist.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text:
...Yes.
Iris, that girl... The sole surviving member of her people whom she has searched for so desperately, [Genepe]...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: If I tell her he's really a [doll] I created using Iris's own genes—a mere shell that lives and breathes, with neither intelligence nor a heart...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...Then Iris will truly fall into utter despair.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...Hmph. In that case, I'll postpone disposing of this doll until then.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주의 영상
lines.text:
...What... is this...? What is this...?!
Wasn't everyone supposed to be happy once we defeated the Demon King?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주의 영상
lines.text:
Iris dealt the Demon King the final blow. As the two of them exchanged words, an enormous, beautiful bird appeared in the air...
The moment it landed on his shoulder, everything changed.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주의 영상
lines.text:
The Demon King's power, which had been evil yet pure darkness itself, became <twisted>.
It struck us with a viciousness beyond anything before it...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주의 영상
lines.text:
Before I lost consciousness, I saw powerful beings appearing one by one from empty space...
Every one of them seemed to possess power to rival the Demon King...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주의 영상
lines.text:
...Choen... Did you know it would come to this?
Did you try to stop Iris because you knew her actions would ultimately ruin the world?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주의 영상
lines.text:
If so, why... Why did you bear it all alone...?
...I don't understand...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주의 영상
lines.text:
One thing is clear...
All of it... Everything... is because of... Iris...!
Urgh... I won't forgive her...
Never! I'll never forgive her!

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text:
...
The moment I thought we'd defeated the Demon King, I felt as though every Agasura in the world was laughing in my ear...

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text: When the Demon King opened his eyes again... there was a hideousness that hadn't been there before... madness... and fierce mockery... He was no longer the Demon King we'd fought, but something else... something I'd met somewhere before... A gaze as though looking at an insect... Ah... I don't know...

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text:
The moment the Demon King lost his power because of me, everything changed.
The sky suddenly tore open... Darkness split apart, and more darkness seeped through...

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text:
Radiant beings appeared everywhere...
Each one like a Demon King... No, closer to a god...

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text:
The moment our world's Demon King lost his power... the wall separating Jiendia from the worlds beyond vanished. Everything lurking in that outer darkness began to look upon our world... with hungry eyes.
Ah...

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text:
...
Are Muwen and Zoe all right? The Dark Moon Princess... Lord Levi protected her, so she should be safe...

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text:
But Lord Levi died in her place...
Genepe... Genepe, too...
And... Kazno...

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text:
...
Kazno is... all right...
Yes... That's right... At the very end, he definitely...

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text: Because he killed me.

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text: ...I... think... I'm going to lose my mind...

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text:
Tears...?
Ah... No... I-I mustn't cry.
I have no right... to pity myself.
What I've done... I have to take responsibility...

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text:
...Ah... But how...? What can I...?
Grandmother... What should I do?

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text: ...Someone... Please...

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text: Help me...

steps.name: 2 Years Ago — Part II
steps.objective: View the memorial hidden in the stone tower at Hell's Door.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text:
Agasura.
The Agasura are exiles from other worlds. They committed grave sins and were banished from their own worlds to Jiendia... Beings forced to live as monsters.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: In other words, our [evil] is not innate... This world forces us to live as monsters... as [darkness].

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: ...Iris is a good girl.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: The innate power flowing in the Tyr's blood... It was given to them to defeat the Agasura. Yet their gentle nature meant they could not stand against us.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: When her grandmother and ... died, leaving Iris alone... all the destiny bestowed upon the Tyr began to gather in that one girl.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: She set out carrying that terrible burden and experienced so much joy and sorrow... Yet it never twisted her. She truly was a good girl.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: A crybaby, quick to anger, willful... Yet this affectionate child accepted her cruel fate and resolved to save the world. I... did not dislike her.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: ...But my name is Kazno.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: I am the eldest brother of those who, though born in different homelands, are bound together by the same vile fate. I am one of the leaders of the Agasura.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: To overcome the [Demon King], who governs the fate that binds us, I joined Choen Palm's plan... and betrayed Iris!

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: Every act of an Agasura must be rooted in [evil]... Otherwise, punishment is inflicted upon the one responsible—sometimes even erasure.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text:
The Agasura are dark, evil beings, destined to perish at the hands of light.
So if I act wickedly, it is natural, something this world itself endorses.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: That is why betraying Iris... was so very easy. The irony of embracing destiny to escape it... Laughable.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: Only now, with my goal achieved... does true revulsion wash over me.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text:
...Iris survived.
That young fool from another world, Siam...
He did not hesitate for even an instant at my proposal.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text:
The [Agasura's contract] was made, and he saved Iris from death.
At the time, I felt a little comforted too.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: But now, this fierce, dark emotion reaches even me from beyond Yggdrasil. It is... Iris's despair.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: Lacking the courage to face her, I intend to make one gamble with little chance of success.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text:
...I can see fragments of light falling from Asgard to the earth.
Those are Memorials. Stones that take intense emotions, memories, and wishes into themselves.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: It is not merely sentiment that makes them look like her tears.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: Such faint, flickering hope falls upon the earth... So very faint... a hope.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text:
In this world, I am now free.
Then... where should I go?

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: Where...?

steps.name: To the Sky
steps.objective: Talk to Jade at the "Collapsed Tower Summit", then travel to "Vanaheim".

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (At the top of the tower, Siam is waiting in Jade's place.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: There is no time for a long discussion.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Siam raises his staff and points to an island floating beyond the clouds.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I am ready to transport you there. Prepare yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Make a choice.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: A curse from the battle with the Demon King prevents me from returning to the ordinary world... But this is no longer an ordinary dimension.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Vanaheim... Separated from its original world and incomplete from the start, this realm is slowly collapsing.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: The bird of flame entered, followed by people from the outside world. Their arrival weakened the ancient barrier.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: That allowed me to come here and hear the situation from the mage called Jade.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: ...Once I have sent you onward, I will try to prevent this place from collapsing.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: So that the darkness filling it does not spill out and corrupt countless dimensions.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: The other half of this little world, I imagine.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: The storm-filled vortex, the powerful barrier guarding the island, the island resting above them...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: In all of it, I sense the same power Iris possessed.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: What lies above is likely a legacy left by the Tyr.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: See for yourself what it is.

choices.text: 3. Is the bird of flame there too?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Without a doubt. Standing here, I can clearly sense its presence beyond the sky.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: But it is greatly weakened. In its current state, it should be unable to resist you.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Its true identity is probably...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: ...No. Let us avoid hasty conclusions.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Jade Or Felix. A promising talent. With diligence, a fine mage will emerge.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Jade has gone to prepare what I requested: materials and people.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: If that goes well, Vanaheim will not vanish, and the other dimensions will remain safe.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Take this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Siam hands you a ring.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: A ring containing the power of spacetime magic. With it, you can reach the place beyond the magical vortex.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: The magic in this ring is also connected to me.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Through it, you can receive my magical power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The ring gives you an unfamiliar feeling.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: ...Now, I must prepare the magic to sustain this world.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Hold fast to your pride.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (With a light movement, Siam leaps from the tower and departs.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (After completing the quest, equip the ring and check the skill window.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A brief wave of dizziness passes. Before you know it, you are standing in the middle of a forest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A forest at midnight. Yet it is not dark.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The night hanging over this place seems as though it will never lift.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (In that respect it resembles the land below, but the scenery is entirely different.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Stars fill the beautiful night sky, and a lake shines silver beneath their light. Did the land below once look like this, before darkness corrupted it?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Yet there is a hollow feeling, as though it could disappear at any moment.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The forest's stillness holds neither corrupted darkness nor malice. Even so, it feels fleeting and uneasy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Somehow, this place reminds you of the girl you met in Xenadia.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Let's explore the area.)

steps.name: The Last Guardian
steps.objective: Explore [Vanaheim]. Someone awaits you at the far end of [Vanaheim].

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Deep in the forest, a woman stands beside an enormous tree.)

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: ...Something unbelievable has happened...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It is the girl from the vision at the stone monument. She is a little older, but there is no mistaking her.)

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: So Vanaheim's barrier... has been destroyed after all.

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: This person... No. I sense no such evil presence from this one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The woman, lost in thought, turns toward you as though startled.)

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: Oh, forgive me. I was speaking to myself.

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: I cannot remember how long it has been since a true guest came here.

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: Traveler, welcome to Vanaheim. My name is Tyr. I am the last inhabitant of this land.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Why do you look so surprised, Traveler? Is there some story behind it?

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Come closer... I would like to hear your tale.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You have met Tyr.)

steps.name: Altar of Ascension
steps.objective: Obtain the <Flower Seal> and <Moon Seal> on the "Flower Path" and "Moon Path", then go to the "Altar of Ascension" inside the "Dream Path".

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: ...This is...
(When you try to move forward, an invisible force pushes you back.)

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: Someone has erected a barrier to prevent passage beyond this point.

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: This form... Could it be...?
(Siam shakes his head, then speaks.)

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: I do not know who is barring your path, or why. But you cannot break through this by force.

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: To dispel this barrier... you will need the Dark Moon Princess's help.

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: The power inherited through the line of Dark Moon Castle... This barrier has been made to respond to it.

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: (Rather than barring the way...)

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: (Is it guiding us...?)

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: Now, hurry. To Aoich!
(Go see the Dark Moon Princess.)

steps.name: A Sorrowful Heart
steps.objective: Meet the Dark Moon Princess at "Cherry Blossom Lake 4" and ask for help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Dark Moon Princess is gazing at the lake.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Mage, you're watching, aren't you? Show yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Siam's apparition appears.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: There is a barrier that only I can break, so you need my help?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: What a strange story. Vanaheim? A part of Jiendia sealed away in ancient times? Why would something connected to me be in such a remote place?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Is whatever lies inside the barrier connected to me? Yes... It must be, mustn't it?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: You know, don't you? What waits there.

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: ...Your suspicion is probably correct, Princess.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Hmph...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: That bird of flame you mentioned... Yes, I saw it in the battle with the Demon King.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: And now I know what it really is...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...Her eyes were so cold when I met her in Valhalla.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I realized that all the years we'd shared, since our first meeting in Aoich, had been a lie.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Her awkward smile when I complained, the times we played and laughed with Ame, the lullabies she sang as gently as my late mother... All of it.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: It was all... a lie.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I'm not going.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I can't forgive her. But I won't help you hurt her, either.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: %s, you've helped me so much. I'm sorry to say this, but...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...I want nothing more to do with her.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Leave.

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (At some point, the Shadow Ninja King and Tengu have appeared behind her, standing guard.)

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: ...There seems little point in trying to persuade her further.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I do?)

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: Didn't you hear the princess? This audience is over. Such insolence! ...Or something like that?

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: I'm truly sorry, but if you trouble the princess's heart any further, I will have no choice but to perform my duty as her retainer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He smiles awkwardly, but the Ninja King seems a little more serious than usual today...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Make a choice.)

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: Oh dear... It can't be helped, then. Prepare yourself!

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: Whew, saved! I hate fights I can't win. But now I've lost a chance to make a joke?!

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: So dejected...

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: [Hmm. Let me offer you a little advice.]

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tengu's voice sounds inside your head.)

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: [The one behind that barrier must be the fiery little chick.]

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: [The chick was probably already in a dreadful state before arriving there.]

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: [Looking at that land with my mind's eye, I can see fragments of the chick's soul scattered everywhere.]

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: [Perhaps pieces of that bleeding soul lodged in the stones you call Memorium. Such stones become Memorials, do they not?]

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: [If you find them, perhaps there will be some clue that can change the princess's mind.]

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: [The princess may speak that way, but I know. The chick's heart was never made of lies alone.]

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: [Haha, I agree. If it had been, this old geezer would have roasted Choen Palm long ago, wouldn't he?]

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: [...Now you're intruding on telepathy too?! Quite a talent, even for a comic-relief character! Who are you calling an old geezer?!]

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tengu begins stomping on the Ninja King...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You decide to follow Tengu's advice and look for Choen Palm's Memorials.)

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: Whew! A worthy protagonist indeed! Even fighting seriously, this is a bit much for me! Though the real reason may be Lord Tengu's halfhearted assistance!

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: But today I am a loyal servant who will gladly lay down his life for the princess. I have no intention of yielding!

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: (Heh, I really am magnificent today. I'll show off every elegant pose I've been practicing!)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Tsukikage.

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: Yes, Princess! Your Tsukikage is here!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: You're noisy.

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Ninja King deflates.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tengu rolls the crumpled Ninja King aside and approaches.)

steps.name: Memories of an Exile
steps.objective: Defeat monsters throughout Vanaheim and collect all of <Choen Palm's Memorials>. Then deliver them to the Dark Moon Princess at "Cherry Blossom Lake 4".

lines.text: (The Dark Moon Princess silently accepts the Memorial you offer.)
(She closes her eyes. The Memorial in her hand begins to glow faintly.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: How could this be...?
(The Dark Moon Princess turns pale.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: She... Choen Palm... hadn't betrayed me.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Choen's despairing soul had been burning itself all along.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: How could anyone do something so cruel...?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Thank you for bringing me this Memorial.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I won't leave her in that madness any longer.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Let's go together. To Vanaheim.
(You decide to go to the Altar of Transcendence with the Dark Moon Princess.)

steps.name: A Certain Game
steps.objective: Collect all of <Choen Palm's Memorials>, then deliver them to the Dark Moon Princess at "Cherry Blossom Lake 4".

lines.text: (Pitch-black darkness. Your body is heavy, as though it has become a sack of water...)
(You are looking into a memory through someone else's eyes.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Who...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Astonishingly, the girl—only a figure in a memory—seems to sense your presence.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But she does not seem fully conscious.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Beyond her hazy awareness, you sense terrible pain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The whole side of her head burns, while something cold and wet runs down the back of it...)
My child... My child...!

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Mo...ther...?

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: Ah! You're awake... Thank goodness. Thank goodness...

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: Heavens... Who did this to my beautiful child...?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: The people...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: They said... Lady Choen Palm can't ascend to heaven because of me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Unable to speak, the woman gathers the girl into her arms.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The girl's consciousness drifts away...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Some time seems to pass.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (...It feels like someone is beside me.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (Am I imagining it...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Should I try asking the girl something?)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (I... I'm just me.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (I don't have a name... I'm not allowed to have one.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (Because my very existence is a sin...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (Because Lady Choen Palm cannot ascend to heaven while I exist.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (Lady Choen Palm is the Priestess of Purification.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (The one who will someday become the Bride of Heaven.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (My older sister...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (They say it's written in the holy scripture.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (To become the Bride of Heaven, Lady Choen Palm must shed every human impurity and become pure.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (So, when she was born, she separated out her filth and had it born apart from her.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (That's me...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (That's why my very existence is a sin.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (When she turns seventeen, Lady Choen Palm will perform the purification ritual.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (When she becomes the Bride of Heaven and burns me, all the sins of the world will burn with me.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (Then everyone will become kind and good, and live happily beside the god of heaven...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (I keep thinking strange things today.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (It's all right...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (If Lady Choen Palm can make everyone happy because of me...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (If Mother can be happy...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (It's all right...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The girl begins to fall asleep.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (With a sensation of falling, you leave the Memorial's memory.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Why...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As before, you are inside the girl's consciousness...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Why...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Another girl, beautifully dressed, lies on the ground before her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She looks a little younger than now, but she appears to be Choen Palm.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Trembling, she looks up at the girl.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Bride of Heaven...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Weren't you going to save the world?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Then why... Why did you do this to Mother...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The girl cradles something blackened in her arms.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It looks like a charred lump of coal...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: She was your mother too...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Why...?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Why did you do this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Though trembling, Choen Palm answers with an expression of disgust.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Whose mother are you calling her, you filthy thing?!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: As if giving birth to the likes of you weren't enough, she tried to help you escape! Her sins overflow!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I bestowed my special mercy and “purified” her with my sacred flames... And you, vermin, show no gratitude!

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Sacred flames...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The girl turns to look back the way she came.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A great pile of firewood, burned black, sends up wisps of cooling smoke.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: It just looks like a wood fire to me...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: If this is what sacred fire looks like...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: What is the salvation written of in the scripture?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: ...Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Taking advantage of the moment the girl looks away, Choen Palm plunges a knife into her body...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But the girl seems to feel nothing.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: M-monster...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: ...Answer me, Bride of Heaven. How are our sins purified?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: How do people become happy?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Th...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: How should I know anything like that?!

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: ...What?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: H-humans follow the god's teachings! For generations, people have served the Bride of Heaven to show that they do not defy him!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: If you live rightly by the scripture's commandments, perhaps the god will mercifully accept even something like you.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Now, stop committing sins. R-repent and submit to your destiny of purification!

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: For generations...?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: You mean there were Brides of Heaven before you, Lady Choen Palm?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...? Yes. I am the 72nd Bride of Heaven.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: The 72nd...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Haha... I see... Now I understand.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Salvation is a human fantasy, and the Bride of Heaven a false symbol. This pathetic story has repeated 72 times. Is that it?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Wh-what did you say?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Seventy-two twins stripped of their names for that reason, kept locked away all their lives, then burned when they turned seventeen...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: It was all... a lie.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ?! L-let go! How dare you lay a hand on this sacred body, you insolent...!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The girl seizes Choen Palm by the throat with one hand and lifts her into the air.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Calling something like this a priestess... Believing her two daughters would save the world...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: If only you'd believed it to the end, it wouldn't have come to this, Mother...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Flames rise from the girl's hand and burn Choen Palm's face.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Aaah! It's hot! It burns! Aaaaaah!

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Yes... You're no Bride of Heaven, no Priestess of Purification.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Perhaps the prophecy was a little mistaken.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Aaaah! Save me! Save me! It burns, it burns, it burns!

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Since you're my sister, I won't let you die.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Burn... until the world ends.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The girl throws Choen Palm's burning body to the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Blackened in an instant, Choen Palm nevertheless remains alive, screaming and writhing...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Yes. You won't need that name anymore... I'll take it.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: All my life, I've wanted a name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The girl who was Choen Palm now cries out in animal screams, no longer words...)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...It was probably my name from the beginning.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Goodbye, my twin sister. I'll show you how the work of a Priestess of Purification should be done.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: From afar, my sister looked beautiful, sacred... I truly loved her.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...But this appearance suits you better.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The girl—no, Choen Palm—raises her hand, and everything around her begins to burn.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As Choen Palm slowly walks outside, the Memorial's memory begins to end...)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Hahahaha... Ahahaha...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choen Palm's sorrowful laughter fades into the distance...)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: A person...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A red wasteland stretches to the horizon. Heat haze rises in dizzying waves.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The scorching heat seems to come not from the sky, but from the earth... No, from her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Stones at her feet have softened in the heat.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (In this unreal landscape, an old man sits on a rock, reading a book.)

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Well, well. At last we meet, Priestess of Purification.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...I'm glad to see you too. It's been seven years since I met another person.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Oh? Hoho... I see. That shows how thorough you've been, Priestess.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: After all, everything in the world has burned in the flames of purification over the last sixty years.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Yes... Just as you say, I've left nothing behind me. Around and around the world, burning everything thoroughly.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: And that is why I must ask you something.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Oh? What is it? I will answer what I can.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Are you the god of heaven?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The old man looks at Choen Palm, then scratches his cheek as if to say, “Oh dear.”)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, a suffocating presence emanates from the old man...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choen Palm braces her whole body against the urge to throw herself down and bow to him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She glares at him fiercely...)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...Answer me. What have you done to me?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Oh...? What are you trying to say, Priestess?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Have you not lived the life into which you were born, making choices of your own free will, right up to this moment?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Don't play word games with me!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Yes. On the day my sister... burned... Mother, my power awoke, and I did what my anger demanded...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: That was my sin...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: But... what is this now? Sixty years roaming the world, destroying everything I saw... Why? I never wanted that!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: No, even on that first day... I... never... wanted... to kill... anyone!

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Yes... How pitiful... But you did.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: As the scripture says, “The Bride of Heaven shall purify the world, and all sins shall be forgiven.”

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Sins... forgiven?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Indeed. Your life was prepared for that purpose from the beginning.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Prepared...?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: What... nonsense is this?! Everyone is dead! What forgiveness? What happiness? What do you mean, the words of scripture?!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: It's wrong. Why did everyone have to die? Why did you make me do this? Why? Why?! WHY?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The old man listens to Choen Palm's anguished cries, falls silent for a moment, then begins to laugh.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (His mouth curves wide as a crescent moon. The old man's “hee-hee” laugh is the most horrifying thing Choen Palm has ever seen...)

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: We shall begin anew, Priestess.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...What?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text:
Now that the old, filthy, worn-out world is purified, we must create a new one, mustn't we?
It has always been this way.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...Always...?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Yes. However beautifully I cultivate a world, it eventually rots and grows dirty.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: After seeing it happen a few times, I established a rule so I could simply wipe it clean.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Now I shall use your flesh and blood as fertilizer to shape a new world. A world that worships your corpse as its Earth Mother will be born.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: For a time, paradise will exist upon this earth... Then humans will gain wisdom and become corrupt. Gradually, the new world will become an old one and approach its end.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Watching worlds rise and fall like that... You might find it surprising, but it never grows dull! Like a storybook whose tales spring up endlessly from a well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choen Palm stares at the old man's smile, utterly stunned.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...How could this be...?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You're no... god of heaven.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You're... mad... You're mad!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: No...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I wasn't born for this!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choen Palm's vision turns red. Enormous flames erupt from her body, seemingly reaching the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (In an instant, the flames fill the horizon and surge toward the old man like a vast tidal wave.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Disappear!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A roar, searing heat, deafening noise.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The flames slowly subside. The old man stands untouched, without a single wound.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (In one hand, he holds Choen Palm by the throat. In the other, he grips something black and writhing.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Urgh... Ghk...

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Hoho... Just as I suspected. You have no intention of becoming my bride, do you, Priestess?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: That's quite all right. I am merciful. I will gladly honor the wishes of my creation.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: What use does a god have for a bride, anyway? Here... I'll use this thing, bearing your curse, as a seedbed for life.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hanging from the old man's hand, Choen Palm thinks she has seen the black, squealing thing beside her somewhere before.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Her mind slowly sinks into darkness.)

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Then... for the sake of the new world, let us remove every remnant of the old.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: As it happens, I know a place perfectly suited to you, Priestess.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: A world overwhelmed by outrageous chaos and darkness, so much so that even its gods fled.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Its destruction is probably near, and life as a slave of darkness will hardly be pleasant... Still, my new world has no need for someone as boring as you. It can't be helped. Farewell!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As the old man's voice recedes, Choen Palm feels herself being pulled somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: (Everything in the world was only a farce staged for him.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: (Everything I was... existed only for that...?)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: (...Mother...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As her consciousness fades, Choen Palm repeats a single thought.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: (I... can't... forgive...)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I will never forgive you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Anger burns away her mind completely, and darkness receives her...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Memorial's memory ends.)

steps.name: The Bird and the Moon
steps.objective: Meet Choen Palm at the "Altar of Ascension" inside the "Dream Path".

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: So this is the Altar of Transcendence?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Hmph. The view is lovely, but for such a grand name, there's nothing here.

lines.speaker: 남자의 목소리
lines.text: Because ornament has no meaning in this place.

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: Kazno...?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Ch-Choen!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Kazno stands at the center of the altar.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Behind him, Choen Palm hangs suspended in the air.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Chains emerging from empty space bind her body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She appears to be unconscious.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: It's been a while, Dark Moon Princess, Mage... And you, we met in Arcadia.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: You look confused. Is it strange to find me here?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Yes... It is an odd place for a chance meeting and a pleasant chat...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choose a question...)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Hmm. Would it help if I said I was stopping her from burning the world with the Demon King's power?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...The Demon King's power...?

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: So it was her... The one who appeared beside the Demon King that day.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Yes. The bird of flame that appeared then was this Choen Palm.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...Then what does stopping Choen have to do with the two of you being here?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Choen Palm had a reason to come here.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: This was the ideal place to remove the Demon King's soul that was binding her mind.

choices.text: 2. Ask about the Demon King's soul.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: That day, Choen Palm took advantage of the moment Iris's killing blow weakened the Demon King and seized his body. The Tyr souls that made up his soul scattered the instant they were separated from him.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Nothing seemed able to hinder her. She wielded her new power freely, defeated Iris's party, and forced the powerful beings trying to cross from other dimensions back into their own worlds.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: She could never have imagined that the doll she created would stand in her way.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...Genepe...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Genepe was a doll Choen Palm created to lure Iris in and plunge her into despair.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: But as the Dark Moon Princess and Siam both witnessed...

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: The boy protected Iris from Choen Palm's attack... and vanished.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Yes. It surprised me too.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: She had made him so much like the Tyr, so much like Iris... Perhaps a wandering Tyr soul came to dwell within him.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: In any case, that was not the only miracle Genepe accomplished.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Many of the souls that had formed the Demon King, which should have scattered mercilessly into the void, gathered around Genepe's soul... and lodged themselves within Choen Palm's mind.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Choen Palm could no longer properly wield the Demon King's power she had finally obtained. Though only a portion, those souls had once formed his soul. They drove her mind to the brink of destruction.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: That is why Choen Palm had to come here.

choices.text: 4. Ask about the Altar of Transcendence.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I said earlier that ornament has no meaning here.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: This was, quite literally, the altar where the Tyr offered their souls and gave birth to the Demon King.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Choen Palm believed that here she could separate the Tyr souls fused with her mind. And indeed, she did.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: She simply didn't expect me to capture her.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...Why?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: You... You're an Agasura, aren't you?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...Honestly, you and Choen fooled us so thoroughly, all this time.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...I've heard the Agasura have three leaders.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: You're one of them, aren't you, Kazno?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: ...Hmm. You've done your homework, Princess.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Don't joke with me.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: She's one of your own. You were working together from the start, even in the battle with the Demon King, weren't you?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: You intended to betray Iris from the beginning, even though you acted so fond of her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For the first time, Kazno's easygoing stream of words stops.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...Hmph!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Then why are you turning against Choen now?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: ...Yes. We were. What we wanted was to break free of the chains that bound us.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Freedom! I wanted freedom for my people, prisoners of their destiny!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Even if that freedom was false...

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: (False...?)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: But Choen Palm had no intention of stopping there.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: What she wanted was to fill the entire world with flame.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Yes, as though she wished to recreate here the horrors of Megiddo, the city of flame deep in the Demon Realm...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Do you think I could let her have the Demon King's power in that state?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Impossible! Choen... No, Choen would never do that. She couldn't!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: You've had a chance to understand her better, have you, Princess?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Well... for the moment, I agree. Choen Palm is cruel to her enemies, but she was never that mad.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Then why...?!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Could it be...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Kazno nods.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: What was she like when you met her in Valhalla? Tell me, Princess. What did you feel? Did betrayal make you tremble with rage?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...Yes. I thought she'd betrayed me. I resented her so much.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: But part of me...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (This isn't Choen. It can't be Choen...!)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I thought it was only a vain hope born of weakness...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: ...And now? What do you think now?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: ...When you fall into the abyss, you become the abyss itself.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Perhaps the seed of flame within her was someone's final source of amusement.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...How could that be...?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: ...Such is the way of things. How many of those the world calls sinners were ever given a choice?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: There is nothing especially unusual about fate being cruel to someone... or even downright evil.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: That's horrible...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Yes. It is.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: But I still have to ask.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Answer me, Dark Moon Princess.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I understand our friend here. They came all this way hoping to find Iris.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: But you, Dark Moon Princess... You came for the woman before us, not Iris.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: What will you do now? What is it you want?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Dark Moon Princess pauses for a moment, then answers without hesitation.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...I'll save her.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I came here to save Choen. We're going back to Aoich together.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Sigh... I knew you'd say that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A quiet, mocking laugh comes from behind Kazno as he scratches his head.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Honestly. This girl hasn't changed a bit.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Choen!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: You're awake.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Choen... Come back with me.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Let's go back to Aoich together. Please...?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You foolish girl... Don't be ridiculous.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Choen...?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Still spouting that muddleheaded nonsense...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: The kind Choen you knew never existed, Princess.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: The woman before you is the morning star of dawn. I live to burn away hypocrisy and corruption for a new age, and return all things to nothingness.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Though this traitor made me fail at the final hurdle...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Heh... A traitor, am I?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Hmph... Time is on my side, regardless. I will fulfill my mission.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: No...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: No. Choen, those aren't your words.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: The one who brought you to this point is still toying with your fate!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: What... are you saying...?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Please... Open your eyes, Choen. Don't let the hatred in your heart defeat you!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: What... What are you talking about...?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Choen!!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Shut up! Shut up, shut up, shut up!!! Be quiet!!! Come closer! I'll burn you first, right here and now!!!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Choen!!! Please!!!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: ───All right. That's enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Kazno, who has been standing quietly, takes a step forward.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A powerful aura suddenly begins to rise from him.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Miss Choen Palm has made her position clear, but I suppose Her Highness has no intention of backing down.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...Kazno... What are you trying to say?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Nothing. We've said enough.

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: No! Kazno!!!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Before I can react, the sword Kazno has drawn is buried in the Dark Moon Princess's chest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Dark Moon Princess stiffens, then crumples to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Best to eliminate a threat as soon as it appears.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Kazno... What have you done...?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: She kept saying she'd free you. I had no choice.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I have no desire to see you destroy the world.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You... You...!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: What's wrong? You look pale. It hardly matters, does it?

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: %s, she's losing far too much blood. If we leave her like this, something terrible will happen...!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have to save the Dark Moon Princess!)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But Kazno blocks my path!)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Hey, weren't you listening just now? Not the sharpest, are you?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Well, if that's how it is... Shall we have a go, my friend?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (In an instant, Kazno fades into the air, and a menacing Agasura appears in his place!)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Hmm. I think that's enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Kazno leaps back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It seems the fight is over...)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Hey, young lady. You don't look very happy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choen Palm is drenched in a cold sweat, writhing in pain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She grits her teeth and glares at Kazno.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You... bastard...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Cho... en...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Dark Moon Princess speaks in a faint voice.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She lies in a pool of her own blood...)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Let's... go back...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: The cherry trees... By... the lake...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...Dark Moon Princess...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: It... hurts...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Help... me... Choen...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Cho...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Dark Moon Princess...?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Oh dear... Is she dead? She must have lost too much blood.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: What a shame.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You... You!!! Kazno!!!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Why are you angry, Choen Palm? A girl who means nothing to you has died. That's all.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Shut up... Shut up...!!!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Weren't you going to purify the whole world with fire, and return everything to nothingness?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: A mortal destined to die has died. Nothing remarkable about that.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Shut up... I...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I don't want that!!!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Ahh... Aaaaaah!!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something is being driven out of Choen Palm.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I cannot see it, but something wrapped around her body in layer upon layer is disappearing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It is as though the chains binding her tight are snapping apart.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Dark Moon...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You foolish girl... You didn't have to do this.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Some bodyguard I turned out to be.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The mark on Choen Palm's forehead burns bright, and her body begins to glow.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...My "wish"... is for the Dark Moon Princess to live again.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Darkness. I'll give you my life in payment for that wish. Take it.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I will decide the price the Dark Moon Princess pays... Take her 'memories' of me.

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: (She can set the price of an 'Agasura's wish' herself? ...Did becoming the 'Demon King' allow her to break some of the Agasura's rules?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choen Palm's body turns white.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Kazno. You bastard. Don't expect me to thank you.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You're clinging to a life that's already ended. I don't know what you hope to accomplish, but give it your best shot...

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: (What...? Then when he made the contract with me, his life was already...)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Dark Moon Princess...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...I think you already gave me what I truly wanted, Princess.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Forget about someone like me. Live a happy life.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...Will we ever meet again?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For an instant, Choen Palm's body shines so brightly that I cannot keep my eyes open.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...Hehehe... What a wretched life it was.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A moment later, she is gone.)

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: ...Choen Palm... It seems she returned to her true self at the very end.

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: Isn't this what you wanted all along, Kazno?

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: Did you want to save her?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Who knows...? Do I look like such a good man?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: She's gone, so I've achieved my objective, at any rate.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Oh, take this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something like a tiny shard of light rises from Kazno's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Glowing faintly, it drifts through the air toward me.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As it draws near, it becomes transparent and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something small and warm has entered my chest...)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: It's part of the fragments of Tyr souls that were tormenting Choen Palm.

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: Tyr souls...?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: They've lost almost all their strength and will probably fade soon. Still, they may be of some use.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Well, I'll be going.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Kazno leaves.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Ah... Welcome back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tyr greets me with a smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But something feels strange...)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: I'm glad I can say goodbye one last time.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: ...The darkness staining my body has been growing stronger.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: When the barrier over this land broke, time began moving for me again.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: In the end, I am destined to become part of the darkness, just like Njord and every other living thing in Vanaheim.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: ...Before that happens, I intend to end things myself, at least.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: If I become a creature of darkness with the power I have now, I would pose too great a threat to the world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tyr falls silent for a moment, then speaks hesitantly.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: ...No matter how far I wandered through this world in my dreams, I was always alone.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: I was happy to meet you at the end of that lonely dream. Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The shard of light Kazno gave me seems to plead for something within my chest.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Let us part... while we can still do so with a smile.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Now, farewell.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Make a choice.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: ...Why?

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Your presence will change nothing...

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: I... cannot hold on any longer.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: I don't want you to see me fall... Don't you understand?

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Please... I cannot end this while you're here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She pleads with me desperately...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But I feel that I absolutely must not leave her.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: You... truly are kind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tendrils of darkness begin creeping up Tyr's body.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: But... foolish.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Why can't you see... that your kindness can be cruel?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Her appearance slowly begins to change.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: ...Ahh... I can feel your soul. Its light is so... sweet...

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: ...What am I saying...? Do you intend to become my original sin?

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: I have to drive you away while I still have my senses...

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Run, now! Or I will force you out!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tyr attacks!)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: I hope you find my descendant, as you wish.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: But please do not take too many risks.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Heh... Little point in saying that to someone who came all the way here, is there?

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: May light, all benevolent beings, and a little luck watch over your path...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tyr says farewell with a gentle smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I leave the forest as she waves goodbye behind me.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I sense a bright, warm light swelling behind my back, then fading away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (At the same moment, the shard of light Kazno gave me vanishes from my chest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It goes out in an instant, like a cry cut short or a flame snuffed out, leaving an emptiness in my chest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I decide to leave the forest without looking back.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: ...I have never seen a warrior like you.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: I was once a teacher to my entire people... Yet I am no match for you.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Why won't you honor my request?

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Only the slightest touch of darkness has changed me this much.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: I never wanted you to see me like this... Why must you shame me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tyr bites her lip.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, the shard of light Kazno gave me begins to stir inside me.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: ...That light?

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: ...What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The shard swells brightly and separates from my body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It slowly begins to take on a human form.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: You... You're... Could it be...?

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: ...I've searched... for so long...

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Ahh... Is this... a dream?

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Isn't this a dream?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The darkness clears, and she returns to her original form.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: This truly... isn't... a dream?

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: I wanted to see you...

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Ahh, ahhh... My baby, my little baby...

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: My baby!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tyr takes Genepe into her arms.)

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: I... kept looking for you, Mom.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: You did... I'm sorry. I'm so sorry...!

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: I kept looking... and looking.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: I missed you too... Mommy missed you too.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Yes... It's been so long. Far too long...

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: But I saw so many things.

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: I helped a girl who looked like you, Mom.

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: And the sunlight is so beautiful in a world without the Demon King. Oh, I have so much to tell you...!

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Yes, tell me. Tell me everything. Mommy's listening.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Stay with me, sweetheart.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: We'll never be apart again...!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tyr and Genepe slowly fade into the light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For a moment, they seem to look my way and nod.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (With the last sound of her tearful laughter, they vanish completely.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Only Vanaheim remains: the forest of memories Tyr dreamed of in her loneliness.)
